/* SQL_ID: AV.AssetValuation.selectList */ SELECT v.ASSET_ID AS assetId, v.CUSTOMER_NO AS customerNo, v.ASSET_TYPE_CODE AS assetTypeCode, atype.CODE_NAME AS assetTypeName, v.VALUATION_AMT AS valuationAmount, v.VALUATION_DATE AS valuationDate, v.VALUATION_STATUS_CODE AS valuationStatusCode, astat.CODE_NAME AS valuationStatusName FROM AV_ASSET_VALUATION v LEFT JOIN CM_CODE_DETAIL atype ON atype.CODE_GROUP = 'ASSET_TYPE' AND atype.CODE_VALUE = v.ASSET_TYPE_CODE AND atype.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN CM_CODE_DETAIL astat ON astat.CODE_GROUP = 'VALUATION_STATUS' AND astat.CODE_VALUE = v.VALUATION_STATUS_CODE AND astat.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY v.VALUATION_DATE DESC, v.ASSET_ID ASC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
